scenes.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: large editorial hero photograph for Mosaic, a premium modern home-office storefront. 3:2 landscape photograph, excellent detail, crisp contemporary design-journal photography. A real software engineer's sophisticated 2026 home workspace. Cool-neutral daylight through large windows, warm white walls, light ash desktop, matte graphite and brushed aluminum hardware, one restrained dark wine-burgundy accent. Modern, fresh, airy and quietly expensive. Natural material texture, clear whites, believable physically correct objects. No vintage furniture, no sepia grade, no golden haze, no brass, no travertine plinths, no velvet, no decorative arches, no collage, no text, no logos, no watermark, no person. Frame the main subjects with generous breathing room so their entire silhouettes remain visible. Primary subject: one pair of premium matte graphite over-ear wireless noise-cancelling headphones, oval cushioned earcups and clean slim headband, lying naturally on a light ash desk, an open slim aluminum laptop softly out of focus at the rear left. A neat closed burgundy notebook at far right. Headphones are the unmistakable hero, filling about half the frame. Three-quarter overhead editorial product-in-use view. Practical, refined headphones for clear video calls and focused coding. No headphone stand.
